messages:
Mia: quick heads-up — stricter fncall schema canary (v2-validator) flipped at 03:40 and we saw a surge in rejects that routed calls to the text fallback. a few paying customers hit it.
Jorge: ouch. is this the union->nullable change we merged yesterday?
Mia: yeah. validator now rejects nulls in the 'items' union. but logs show a lot of rejects are actually truncated arrays from the tool-adapter stream being cut. debugger copy below.
Eric: paste a line?
Mia: ```[2026-03-22T03:41:05Z] WARN validator: reject code=SCHEMA_MISMATCH route=shipment-tool details="expected non-null for union 'items' at index 2" request_id=req_9b3
[2026-03-22T03:41:05Z] INFO adapter: stream_closed_midframe bytes_recv=640 bytes_expected=1024 adapter=adapter-3 request_id=req_9b3```
Nina: that matches what we saw earlier with batching spikes. validator can't tell "hard mismatch" vs "stream cut" because both produce partial JSON.
Jorge: console currently just shows 'structured_rejects' and a raw count. we need a dimension for reject_code + route. without that it's impossible to diagnose.
Eric: operational ask: add metric "validation.rejects_by_route_and_code" (tag: route, code) and emit special error_code=STREAM_CLOSED when adapter closes midframe.
Mia: agreed. product ask: in rollout UI add a coercion toggle for fncall validators (coerce-nullable-arrays: on/off) and a safety slider: if on then instead of fallback to text, route to immediate retry queue (same variant) up to N times.
Jorge: perf thought: retries will increase token cost and latency; we should gate by route-level SLO label. add policy: retry_on_partial if slo_class!=latency_critical and retry_budget_remaining>0.
Nina: add a console tile showing "retry impact" during rollout: tokens_consumed, extra latency p90, success-after-retry ratio. also ability to pause rollout if token spike > 20%.
Eric: instrumentation note: sample 1/10 of rejects with full payload attached for offline replay. need to ensure PII redaction before storage.
Mia: security note acknowledged. we'll run redaction hooks in the adapter before enqueueing samples.
Jorge: short-term mitigation: revert canary to v1-validator and roll a targeted patch to adapters to emit STREAM_CLOSED code. long-term: enhance validator to inspect adapter-close metadata and treat those as 'retryable' rather than definitive rejects.
Mia: i'm pushing the revert now. ops-bot: revert rollout 7965439999 -> v1-validator started.
ops-bot: revert complete on canary hosts 2/3, draining traffic from remaining host.
Nina: i'll prototype the dashboard tiles and the UI coercion toggle in console-staging. Eric — can you own the sampled payload pipeline and redaction?
Eric: yep. will sketch a retention plan and add sampling flag to validation telemetry.
Mia: follow-ups: (1) adapters emit STREAM_CLOSED code and partial_stream counter, (2) validation telemetry dimension by route+code, (3) console tile for retry impact and a rollout coercion toggle, (4) sampled payloads with redaction for replay. update RFC after deploy.
Jorge: good plan. thanks team. :rocket:
thread_summary: Canary of a stricter fncall schema caused rejects that were actually adapter stream truncations. Team agreed to revert, add STREAM_CLOSED error codes, per-route+code telemetry, sampled payloads with redaction, and a console rollout toggle to coerce/ retry instead of text fallback.
